notes.title: Game update 1.2.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41183946/9f58a74753afe49aaadad73b52c7e6fa2eaa831b.png[/img]

We have listened to your feedback and are happy to update the game with the following changes:

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Game Engine has been updated to Unity [strike]2021.3[/strike] 2021.3.15
[*] Added ingame control sheet (readme)
[*] [b]Microphone[/b] - You can now use CAPSLOCK key to speak.
[i]Ensure that you'll set your default microphone within Windows.[/i]
[/list]

[h2]Instructions[/h2]
There were some complaints about instructions. Ingame most controls were visible on the display already by toggling with the TAB key. However, we now included the new question mark icon top-right which will open a modal with instructions. You can also press ESCAPE en then choose for controls option.

tags.feature: [*] [b]Microphone[/b] - You can now use CAPSLOCK key to speak.

notes.title: Game update v1.2
notes.content:
This update contains a small fix and a few updates.

[list]
[*] Game Engine has been updated to Unity [strike]2020.3[/strike] 2021.3
[*] Overal game engine performance improved
[*] Start screen contains background music and switching backgrounds
[*] Removed jingles due to copyright audio
[*] Added the option to add your own Jingles with name (jingle_xx.wav). Replace xx with numbers 1 - 12 for the F (function) keys.
[*] Added cookies to the spotlights for a more realistic effect
[*] Added a second location (empty, better performance)
[*] Added light beam effect on the center sphere
[*] Ready for release
[/list]
